notes: RHoMIS household survey of 821 households in four Tanzanian regions; multivariate probit of five 'CSA' technologies. Only agroforestry ('inclusion of trees in agricultural ﬁelds') maps to a defined practice (trees_in_farmlands; subtype not stated). Crop diversity, livestock diversity, chemical fertilizer and irrigation are not defined practices and were not extracted. Table 4 cross-equation correlations (agroforestry with fertilizer 0.121*, irrigation 0.104*, crop diversity 0.114, livestock diversity -0.041) are complementarities, not adoption drivers; not extracted. Constant term of the agroforestry equation (-1.165 (0.313)**) not extracted. Survey year not stated. Discussion cites other studies' agroforestry rates (Nyasimi 85%, Mwungu 14%): secondary, not extracted.
